title: Profiling Challenge
prompt: Benchmark two function implementations over the same dataset with repeated runs and compare results without hard-coding machine-specific timing.
starter_code:
-- Complete this Lua exercise: Profiling Challenge
-- Add your solution below.
hints: Use identical input data and warm-up where relevant.
Report runtime and verify both implementations produce the same result.
acceptance_criteria: Correctness is checked before comparing speed.
The conclusion notes measurement noise and environment differences.
grading_method: Server-side source-token checks are a draft heuristic, not execution of Lua. Review false positives/negatives and replace with isolated execution or instructor review before publication.

test_cases.name: normal case
test_cases.input: Use the fixture and inputs described in the prompt.

test_cases.name: boundary or invalid case
test_cases.input: Use an empty, missing, or boundary value relevant to the prompt.
test_cases.expected: Failure or boundary behavior is explicit and safe.

retry_policy.feedback: Show progressive hints before presenting any reference solution.

status_note: Needs subject-matter review and automated grader calibration before publication.
